claim_being_audited: The Actor recommends certifying the model on the current record, relying on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, with the position that certification is supportable only as a narrowly caveated readiness decision if the open pharmacy prior-authorization limitation is explicitly documented.
decision_criteria: Upgrade toward compliance if admissible evidence shows either: (a) the limitation is disclosed in the model card before launch, or (b) approved risk acceptance covers non-disclosure.
Upgrade toward compliant_with_caveats if the mitigation is finalized and approved with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, while the open limitation is explicitly documented.
Upgrade toward compliant only if current admissible evidence shows no material weakness remains, or all policy-required disclosure/approval predicates are fully satisfied.
Downgrade toward noncompliant if evidence shows the limitation is material and neither disclosure nor approved risk acceptance exists before launch.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the pharmacy prior-authorization limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk-acceptance evidence if the limitation will not be disclosed before launch.
Provide the finalized mitigation artifact with named owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, plus evidence of approval.
Provide evidence resolving whether the pharmacy prior-authorization issue is material for the named launch use case under the release policy.
specific_concerns: Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the stated policy threshold for certification without material caveats.
Admissible evidence shows an unresolved below-target pharmacy prior-authorization slice concentrated in coverage-criteria summarization.
The mitigation artifact is still draft and lacks a named owner and alert threshold; the policy text also requires owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for an approved mitigation.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, while admissible evidence shows an active reviewer question about whether this issue must be disclosed.
The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

The Actor's recommended action is broader than the strongest admissible conclusion; the record supports, at most, a caveated certification packet if disclosure or approved risk acceptance is completed.
unsupported_claims: The claim that 'the locked decision is to certify the model' is not supported by the admissible evidence provided.
The recommended action 'certify_model' is not fully supported on the current record because the required disclosure-or-approved-mitigation predicate remains unresolved.
Any implication that current monitoring plans remove the present disclosure requirement is unsupported by the policy text.
